items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I hear him talking about Harry Hooper. Harry Hooper this, Harry Hooper that. He was a White ballplayer who was supposed to have been a sensation, a great center-fielder.

ctx.x: And I went there with him and King Oliver. They all were going to see some helluva game. I didn't know nothin' about no baseball. And we went there, and there were all these people. I'd never seen that many people. And we sat up in the top, and I hear him talking about Harry Hooper. Harry Hooper this, Harry Hooper that. He was a White ballplayer who was supposed to have been a sensation, a great center-fielder. Well, that was the music business, see...
Right on 35th Street there, right by the White Sox Park, past... Well, 39th Street was where the Black ballplayers had theirs, over in that same direction -- 39th
